![](rtx_pro.jpg){fig-align=center}

**Ending 2025 on a High Note, Kicking Off 2026 with Excitement! 🎉**
We’re thrilled to share some fantastic news as we wrap up an amazing year and look forward to even greater things in 2026!

The 𝗶𝗛𝘂𝗺𝗮𝗻 𝗟𝗮𝗯 at 𝗢𝗸𝗹𝗮𝗵𝗼𝗺𝗮 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝘁𝘆 has been selected for the prestigious **𝗡𝗩𝗜𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗔𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗰 𝗚𝗣𝗨 𝗚𝗿𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗺**, and we couldn’t be more excited!

This incredible opportunity is made possible by NVIDIA’s support for our cutting-edge work on **𝘕𝘦𝘶𝘳𝘰𝘢𝘥𝘢𝘱𝘵𝘪𝘷𝘦 𝘙𝘰𝗯𝘶𝘴𝘵 𝘛𝘦𝘭𝘦𝘰𝘱𝘦𝘳𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯 𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘩 𝘍𝘰𝘳𝘮𝘢𝘭 𝘎𝘶𝘢𝘳𝘢𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘦𝘴**. With the help of 𝟰× **RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q GPUs**, we’ll be driving innovative research at the intersection of **AI, robotics**, and **human-centered systems**.

We are incredibly grateful for NVIDIA’s support and are eager to see how this partnership will enhance our research, bringing us closer to solving some of today’s most complex challenges.

Wishing everyone a fantastic start to 2026! 🎆
